question:
Select the figure from among the given options which when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1ac27022c56d17a12efbf21814b31075dbf53b3a6bbbe32bccfdf7b1fe7c4b4.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) The circle element shift anticlockwise alternately at corner and side of the quadrilateral element.

2) No change in the quadrilateral element. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c4c7a3218764922da0e6bdebf25ffff6cc89fa9b5cac33a089b3d479a0b22e4.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57cb693ad86fb016a58943b9585dc58c25c089e45fb6108fe3757b892188be39.png] 

Hence. "Option 2" is the correct answer.
